name: GET_REALIZED_GAINS
description: Computes the realized gain/loss for each sell transaction using FIFO cost basis.

params.name: transactions
params.description: A sheet-style range with transaction rows. Expected columns: [date, wkn, type, shares, price, fees, total]

returnDesc: A result matrix suitable for Google Sheets containing rows of: [date, WKN, sold quantity, cost basis of sold shares, net proceeds, realized PnL, return ratio]. Returns a single empty row when there are no realized sell events.

name: GET_FIFO_POSITIONS
description: Returns the current open FIFO positions for each stock in the transaction history.

params.name: transactions
params.description: A sheet-style range where each row is a transaction record. Expected columns: [date, wkn, type, shares, price, fees, total]

params.name: stockData
params.description: A sheet-style range for stock metadata. Expected columns include WKN in column A and stock name in column D.

returnDesc: A two-dimensional array suitable for Google Sheets output with rows of: [WKN, stock name, active shares, cost basis, average buy price]. Returns a single empty row when there are no active positions.

name: GET_POSITION_XIRR
description: Calculates MWRR/XIRR for a specific stock or the full portfolio.

params.name: wknFilter
params.description: The WKN to analyze, or 'TOTAL' to evaluate the entire portfolio.

params.name: transactions
params.description: Transaction rows with fields [date, wkn, type, shares, price, fees, total].

params.name: dividends
params.description: Dividend rows with at least [date, wkn, ..., net payout].

params.name: stockData
params.description: Stock metadata rows used to look up the current market price.

returnDesc: The annualized XIRR rate as a number, or the string '#N/A' when the calculation fails.
